Lemma
[Pointed backward limits of the King--Rosenau solution] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0097 1. ch29:29.5\group King–Rosenau Solution

For base points $((s_i,\theta _i),t_i)$ in cylindrical coordinates with $t_i\to -\infty $, the pointed limit is a cigar, a flat cylinder, or a cigar with the opposite orientation according as $2t_i-s_i$ tends to $-\infty $, a finite number, or $+\infty $.
